en:
* Added developer commentary; Ernesto provides the narration (available only after completing this mod once).
* *Ernesto loves facing each other atop the two pairs of jagged stumps near the waterfall.*
* Added new dialogue for Gabbro, Chert, Esker, Riebeck, and Feldspar.
* Adjusted the rendering order so that HUD markers remain visible even when inside clouds.
* Fixed an issue where the "unidentified signal" notification would disappear upon acquiring Gabbro's signal when starting a new save file.
* Adjusted the content of several ship log entries.
